description: Overview: The "Download Button by JTA" is a powerful custom visual for Power BI that enables users to export their selected data directly to CSV — quickly, easily, and without technical setup. Built with performance and flexibility in mind, it’s ideal for sharing insights beyond Power BI. Key Features: Large-Scale Export: Export from 300,000 rows and up to 15 columns of data to CSV with a single click. User-Controlled Output: Only the columns added by the user are included — what you see is what you export. Customizable UI: Adapt the button’s style and layout to seamlessly match your report’s design. Benefits: Bypass Power BI Limits: Overcome the platform’s built-in export restrictions for large tables. Enable Deeper Analysis: Empower end-users to continue their exploration outside Power BI using familiar CSV tools like Excel or Python. Frictionless Sharing: Make it easy for viewers to access curated data slices without needing edit access or DAX expertise. Constraints: The custom visual leverages the browser’s cache memory. It works by fetching data in chunks of 30k rows, storing each chunk in the browser's cache until the entire dataset is compiled for download. This incremental approach requires the use of browser memory to ensure seamless processing.
